text:
alex: Starting staged rollout for inference-runtime v2026-03-20. Canary -> 10% traffic globally, preferentially shifting new sessions. Change window announced for 23:00-01:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: @channel Rollout triggered: id=rl-58321, target=10%, models=[runtime-v2026-03-20]. Stages: canary(10%), then 50%. Logs will appear in #eng-releases.

ops-east: Noted — small p50 bump in eu-west right after shift: baseline p50 120ms -> 165ms (+45ms). p95 looks stable for now.

marta: Thanks. Can we hold for 15m and validate KV cache warming? If cold-starts are the cause we should avoid broader expansion. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj: I'm watching. Pushed quick routing toggle we can flip: `route override inference.europe=runtime-v2026-03-20:10%` (non-persistent).

lina: Seeing increased cold starts on a subset of eu-cache hosts, logs show a flurry of `kv_cache_miss` entries and slow load times. Sample: `2026-03-20T22:12:04Z GET /infer 504ms kv_cache_miss=true`.

sre-runner: Also a small uptick in client retries from two big customers in eu (0.18% -> 0.9%). Not yet breach but clustering in the same AZ.

alex: Okay decision call: hold canary at 10% for now. Conditions to auto-rollback = p50 delta > +100ms or error_rate increase > +0.5% sustained for 3 min. If either hit, we'll pin EU back to runtime-v2026-03-12 (previous).

marta: Agree. Can someone pin EU and add a shortfirebook entry? I'll update the release notes to mark "hold for cache warm" and note the change window.

raj: Done. Pin applied: `route set inference:eu=runtime-v2026-03-12 --pin --reason "cache warm fallback"`

deploy-bot: Traffic adjustment complete: inference.europe -> runtime-v2026-03-12 (pinned). Canary remains 10% global pointing at runtime-v2026-03-20 for non-EU.

ops-east: After pin, p50 in eu-west dropped back toward baseline within 90s. Continued monitoring.

lina: Confirming KV cache hit-rate recovering on pinned hosts; misses decreasing.

alex: Good. We'll keep the canary at 10% non-EU for another 30m. Raj please prepare a staged warmup plan for EU hosts (gradual cache prefill + lean warmup jobs). Also add a changelog note: "Deferred EU expansion due to cache warmup — pinned to prior runtime."

marta: I updated release notes and change window in the doc. Added a short note for support: how to detect this issue and the rollback command.

sre-runner: I'll create a short incident checklist in case we need to escalate.

alex: Thanks team. Action items: (1) raj: warmup job + plan (ETA 20m), (2) marta: release note updated (done), (3) ops-east/sre: keep eyes for 30m. If metrics stable, we'll resume EU expansion via gradual +5% increments. :thumbsup:

ops-east: Acknowledged. Will post a follow-up if anything changes.

alex: I'll close the public change window note to indicate hold. Reopen when green.

marta: Marking thread resolved for now; will reopen if we flip the pin or rollback. :white_check_mark:
